title: Federal Judge Finds Trump’s Halt on Wind Energy Is Illegal

title: A Data Center Wrapped in a Mystery Comes to the New Mexican Desert
content: As wealthier areas are pushing back against huge A.I. data centers, speculators are pitching places like Doña Ana County, N.M., on their vision. Local officials are eager for a deal — even if they don’t quite know the terms.
